result.summary: Encloses all code content within include guards in three header files where lines fell outside. Updates `test/lint/lint-include-guards.py` to flag any non-comment lines appearing before `#ifndef` or after `#endif`.
result.problem: Three headers contain content outside their include guards, preventing compilers from applying once-only header optimizations and leaving the codebase without automated checks to prevent similar regressions.
evidence: Author references GCC once-only header documentation regarding proper guard placement (description: 'From https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/cpp/Once-Only-Headers.html')
Author states this is a 'prerequisite for https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36808'
result.scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup across three header files and one test linter script.
result.card: Encloses all code in three header files within their include guards and updates test/lint/lint-include-guards.py to enforce that non-comment lines do not exist outside guards. This ensures compilers can apply multiple-include optimizations for once-only headers and prevents future regressions. The author cites GCC documentation on header guards and notes this PR is a prerequisite for PR 36808.

risk.why: Mistakes would lead to build or linter CI failures rather than runtime or consensus issues.
